recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit out-of-build core SupplyRequest or SupplyDelivery example files for FHIR-2945. If future work is needed on current successor-resource examples, evaluate the OO Incubator repository rather than reopening this historical core issue as a current core source defect.
issue_request: FHIR-2945 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue for the OO work group. It reported that the Supply resource XML example only contained an "insert contents here" placeholder and asked for a real example, with Jira showing the change as applied for DSTU1.
initial_application: The request was applied in July 2014: commit 7a458ddc5dc41ad3d7223150d12d251bee2f8f3b added a populated source/supply/supply-example1.xml example, commit cca3b4c862ec4696e519794582e39919136eeab4 updated the Supply spreadsheet source, and commit 9ca439115e8240b9ec61b218fb4b0ae724262950 immediately fixed coding errors in the new example.
additional_context: The original Supply resource was later split into SupplyRequest and SupplyDelivery by FHIR-6067, and the current core source no longer builds Supply or its successors. source/fhir.ini lists Supply under removed resources and has no active SupplyRequest or SupplyDelivery resource entries. Later core history removed the OO supply resources from fhir.ini and current narrative links now point SupplyRequest and SupplyDelivery to the HL7 OO Incubator continuous build. The checked-in successor-resource directories still contain historical files, including an unlisted placeholder example, but those files are outside the current core build scope. The combined branch already contains an audit commit for FHIR-6067.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source files were edited because the seed request was historically applied and remaining local successor-resource placeholders are inactive source that do not affect the current built FHIR core specification.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-6067 split the original Supply resource into SupplyRequest and SupplyDelivery, explaining why the seed artifact no longer exists as an active core resource; it is already represented on the combined branch by defea1478a7ffa142adc3222f7020cf61a3ee614.
